pages.summary: Clarified subtransaction rollback, error propagation and handler journaling obligations; removed the blanket safety guarantee.
Reorganized lookup, providers and stock handlers into a concise reference; removed the nontransactional metering sample and clarified comparator limits.
Separated resources, cauldron limits, item containers and player interaction; retained quantization and immediate-effect warnings.
Separated provider registration from automation selection and transfer rules; clarified the distinction from ENTITY_ITEMS.
Tabulated handler types and NeoForge counterparts and clarified directional contexts and transactional transfers.
Added living-entity equipment coverage and slot tables; marked the uncompiled trade example rust,ignore and retained transaction effect rules.
